caption: The drawing features a large, ornate, scalloped-edged oval plate colored in shades of pale green and blue. Around the outer edge of the plate, in all capital letters, is the phrase “GIVE US THIS DAY OUR DAILY BREAD,” written in green with a black outline. Inside the border, towards the center, there is a green banner with the words “LIBERTY AND FREEDOM 1776” in white uppercase letters. Centered on the plate is a gray and black bird, which resembles an eagle, perched atop a white document labeled “CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES” in black uppercase letters. In the upper right corner of the background, there is a small outline of a cloud, drawn in light blue. The artist's signature, "M.A.R.E.," is located in red in the bottom right area of the plate. There are also two brown smudges or marks on the left and right edges of the plate. The entire image is rendered using pencil, ink, and watercolor, primarily in muted tones of blue, green, gray, and black.
title: Bread Plate
